# Republican support for Trump has fallen as Democrats hold a big lead among enthusiastic midterms voters

August 18, 2026

According to this week's Economist / YouGov Poll, about one-third (35%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Donald Trump's job performance as president, and 61% disapprove.
